title: Example Domain

findings.problem: Insufficient contrast ratio on primary call-to-action link
findings.why_it_matters: Low contrast text makes content unreadable for users with low vision or color vision deficiencies.
findings.fix: Increase contrast ratio to at least 4.5:1 by darkening text color.

findings.problem: Hero illustration img tag is missing an alt attribute
findings.why_it_matters: Screen readers announce the raw image filename or skip the element entirely without descriptive alt text.
findings.fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute describing the image content.
findings.evidence: element has empty or missing alt attribute
findings.verified_note: Verified img element #2 lacks alt attribute in DOM snapshot

findings.problem: Mobile navigation icon touch target is below recommended 44x44px
findings.why_it_matters: Small tap targets cause frustration and unintended clicks on touch-enabled mobile devices.
findings.fix: Add padding or min-width/min-height of 44px to the button.
findings.verified_note: Verified element badge 3 exists on page snapshot

findings.problem: Repository is missing an open source LICENSE file
findings.why_it_matters: Without an open source license, default copyright laws apply, preventing legal use, modification, or distribution.
findings.fix: Add an open source license file (such as MIT or Apache-2.0) at the repository root.
findings.evidence: No LICENSE, LICENCE, or COPYING file found in repository root

findings.problem: README command references requirements file 'requirements-dev.txt' which does not exist in repository
findings.why_it_matters: Users following installation instructions will encounter a FileNotFoundError.
findings.fix: Create 'requirements-dev.txt' or update the README command with the correct path.

findings.problem: HTTP API request in client does not handle network timeout exceptions
findings.why_it_matters: Uncaught network timeouts crash CLI execution instead of presenting graceful recovery guidance.
findings.fix: Wrap HTTP request in a try-except block catching httpx.TimeoutException.
